artworks.title: Civitella Seen from the North
artworks.medium: oil paint over indented lines on beige prepared laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Purchased as the Gift of Helen Porter and James T. Dyke
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape painting with an elevated point of view. A ridge leads towards distant peaks. The horizon is in the upper third, with buildings atop the central ridge. The brushstrokes are broad and expressive, capturing the texture of the terrain. The sky has a mix of blues and grays with clouds. The color palette includes earthy tones for the landscape and cooler hues in the sky. The hillside is steep with grass and shrubs, leading the eye into the distance where the hills recede.

artworks.title: Ruth and Boas
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures engaged in agricultural activities. The scene shows an agrarian landscape with multiple figures standing and working amidst tall grass or crops. The foreground features a woman holding a sheaf of wheat, with two men at her side. Additional figures in the background are working the field. The drawing showcases detailed line work capturing the folds of clothing, texture of the foliage, and expressions of the figures. In the background are trees, distant hills, and fluffy clouds in a softly contoured sky, conveying a pastoral atmosphere of rural life.

artworks.title: Rock Formations near Olevano
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over graphite, touched with watercolor, on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a nature scene with a viewpoint slightly above rocky terrain. Near the upper third of the composition, there are silhouette-like buildings among trees. The rocky slope to the right is depicted with precise line work, emphasizing textures and forms. Trees are detailed with fine brushstrokes, giving them a soft look. The color palette is subtle and muted, focusing on earth tones and sepia washes. In the distance, the land slopes leftwards with more trees and hills blending into the structures under a pale sky.

artworks.title: An Italianate Landscape with Shepherds
artworks.medium: pen and gray ink with brown and gray wash over graphite on gray laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image portrays a pastoral scene with a broad view of the landscape. The horizon is at the upper third of the image, with distant mountains against a softly stroked sky. The brushstrokes are detailed, showing trees and natural surroundings. The color palette consists of sepia tones. In the foreground, a man and his dog stand by a stream with cattle and a sheep. In the background, figures tend to a herd of sheep, and trees create depth.

artworks.title: In Praise of Modesty
artworks.medium: red chalk on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of two full-body figures. One figure is seated on a textured surface with a serious expression. The other figure stands in a contrapposto position with raised arms, appearing to be in motion. Both figures are nude with different hair styles. The background features a lattice with intertwined foliage.

artworks.title: The Golden Age I
artworks.medium: red chalk on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures. The composition includes figures sketched in a rough style using red chalk or crayon. In the foreground, there is a seated figure seen from the back, depicted slightly larger than the others. Behind and around this figure, other figures are shown interacting in various poses. The lines are quick and sketchy, conveying dynamic movement and an informal study. The drawing captures a sense of intimacy and fluidity, focusing on the human form in a shared space.

artworks.title: Adolf Zimmermann
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a person with short, light-colored hair wearing a coat and a cap. The person is facing forward with a calm expression. The background is plain. There is an inscription to the left of the person with the date "1828" and the word "Rome."

artworks.title: The Gulf of Pozzuoli
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with water, landforms, a fortress or castle on a promontory, vegetation, sailboats near the coast, and a muted color palette.

artworks.title: Und Doch!
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash, heightened with white, over graphite, on light green wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing with their arms raised above their head. They have a serious expression, short, wavy hair, and are unclothed. The background has a blend of dark and light washes, creating a fluid, cloudy atmosphere. The image is rendered in monochromatic tones.

artworks.title: A Seated Young Woman Wearing a Fashionable Hat
artworks.medium: black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts the side profile of a woman seated with bent legs. She has delicate facial features, styled curly hair adorned with flowers and ribbons, and is wearing a dress with short sleeves and flat slippers. The background is plain with shading.

artworks.title: The Artist's Wife Reading in Bed
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper, laid down
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Purchased as the Gift of Merritt P. Dyke

artworks.title: Diana Resting after the Hunt
artworks.medium: watercolor, pen and gray ink, and gray wash, heightened with touches of white gouache, over graphite, laid down on old album sheet
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Purchased as the Gift of Diane A. Nixon
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various mythological figures and animals in a whimsical scene. The scene features elegantly dressed women and mythical creatures among trees and animals. Some figures appear to be floating or perched in a theatrical setting, with cherubic figures carrying a large drape. On the ground, there is a lively gathering with dogs, food, and drink, creating a sense of festivity and merriment. The image uses bright and soft colors to convey a playful and dreamlike quality. The figures are attired in green and pinks, enhancing the festive atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Waterproof Coat of General Moltke
artworks.medium: graphite with black and gray wash heightened with white gouache on tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Purchased as the Gift of Helen Porter and James T. Dyke
artworks.description: The image shows two sections of a dark coat - the left side displays the sleeve while the right side shows the front with a collar. The coat appears crumpled with shading on the fabric. The color palette is primarily brown, black, and grey. Surrounding the coat are sketches and handwritten notes on a beige background. The central and lower part of the image is occupied by the coat.

artworks.title: A Fashionable Young Woman Seen from Behind
artworks.medium: black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a person from the back, with their full body visible. They are depicted standing, with one hand holding up part of their long, flowing dress and the other hand raised, holding a parasol. The person's facial features are not visible due to the angle, but they have elaborate hair adorned with feathers and floral embellishments. They are wearing a high-collared gown that appears to be draped and cinched at the waist with a bow. The person also has a chain or cord hanging from their waist and is holding a parasol with a pointed handle and a scalloped edge. The background is plain and does not include any additional details.

artworks.title: Tivoli and the Waterfalls with Shepherd Families
artworks.medium: pen and black ink over graphite, with border lines, on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image features figures in a landscape, with a cityscape in the distance. Close to us, there are seated women, one holding a child, a man with a hat and staff, and a dog, among trees and plants. A goat is also visible. In the distance, there is a cityscape with various buildings, including a dome and towers. Beyond the figures and trees, the land ascends to rolling hills and cliffs, with trees between the structures and the sky. The horizon is low, emphasizing the sky filled with fine lines indicating clouds. The art style includes intricate line work for texture and detail, seen in the foliage and architecture. The color palette is monochromatic, focusing on line work rather than color.

artworks.title: Dresden from the Banks of the Elbe River
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash and watercolor over traces of graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a riverside scene with a view of the riverbank and the city's old architectural structures in the distance. A bridge spans the river on the horizon, connecting both sides. Close by, people are on the riverbank engaged in various activities with boats docked nearby. The brushstrokes are precise, and the color palette is earthy and muted. The sky has clouds casting shadows in the scene.

artworks.title: A Storm over the Mountains near Nocera
artworks.artist: Attributed to Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a valley surrounded by hills, with buildings on a distant hill. The landscape is depicted with expressive brushstrokes, emphasizing the texture of the scene. The color palette is sepia-toned. Figures are walking on a path near shrubs and trees. In the background, there is a building with a chimney and tall trees. The sky has clouds and beams of light.

artworks.title: Shriveled Leaves
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with touches of black wash over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows two curled leaves in a detailed pencil drawing. The larger leaf is at the center, leaning slightly to the left, while the smaller leaf is at the bottom right corner. The color palette is monochromatic with grayscale tones for shading. The background is plain off-white.

artworks.title: Ottavio Lancellotti, Principe di Lauro
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a pencil drawing of a man centered on his head and shoulders. He is facing slightly to his left, showing a three-quarter view of his face. The man has a broad forehead, wide eyes, and a slightly curved mouth with a calm expression. His hair is short and wavy, framing his face. His clothing is faintly sketched, and there are no visible accessories. The background is a blank canvas with handwritten text in the top right corner.

artworks.title: Ruins of a Fortified Tower among Wooded Hills
artworks.medium: watercolor with pen and gray ink over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image features a landscape seen from above. The horizon is high, with distant hills and treetops. A tower covered in greenery stands out among lush vegetation. The scene is detailed and naturalistic, with precise brushstrokes capturing textures. The background shows a range of earth tones blending into the sky. Rich greens, browns, and soft colors dominate the color palette.

artworks.title: Tivoli and the Temple of the Sibyl Above the Aniene Gorge
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash, touched with watercolor, over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Purchased as the Gift of Ivan E. and Winifred Phillips in Memory of His Brother Neil F. Philips
artworks.description: The image features an aerial view overlooking a landscape with cliffs, trees, and water. A distant city or village is seen on rocky cliffs in the horizon. The brushstrokes are detailed, typical of wash drawings, with gray and brown tones creating depth and form. The color palette is muted with earth tones, including grays, browns, and greens, with hints of blue in the water.

artworks.title: Design for a City Gate in Trier
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash and watercolor over traces of graphite on laid paper, laid down
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of architectural designs showcasing archways and elevations. On the left side, there is an ornate archway with classical detailing including columns, a triangular pediment, and a central cartouche, topped with a decorative sculpture suggesting maritime themes. On the right, there is a cross-sectional view of a simplified arch structure highlighted in pink tones, illustrating a cut-through side view of the arch. Both designs are annotated with measurements and notes, likely for construction or architectural planning. The drawing emphasizes symmetry and ornamental design in an architectural context.

artworks.title: River Landscape with a Waterfall (recto)
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray and red wash, heightened with white gouache on blue laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Purchased as the Gift of Alexander M. and Judith W. Laughlin
artworks.description: The image shows a turbulent stream with rushing water flowing towards the viewer. The scene is surrounded by tall rocks and dense foliage that obscure the horizon. Trees with branches extending over the water and leaves scattered across the top of the image. The brushstrokes are rapid and expressive, giving a loose, sketch-like quality to the scene. The color palette is earthy with muted greens and browns contrasting with the whites and grays of the water.

artworks.title: The Last Judgment
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over traces of red and black chalk, squared for transfer with black chalk, on cream laid paper
artworks.dimensions: overall: 41.5 x 19.7 cm (16 5/16 x 7 3/4 in.), arched top
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythical or religious scene. The drawing shows several figures in different positions and actions. The composition is divided into two main sections with figures in the upper levels and lower levels. The upper section appears to depict a group of figures witnessing or participating in an event. The lower section shows figures in dynamic poses with swords or engaged in struggle. The scene is detailed with a brownish wash for tonal contrast.
